svg.title: Decoding curves
svg.desc: Relative luminance against encoded value for the sRGB curve and for power curves of 1.8, 2.2, 2.4 and 2.6, over the full range and near black on logarithmic axes. The curves differ most in the dark tones; near black the sRGB curve becomes a straight line and gives far more light than a 2.2 power.
